name: greengrassv2
description: IoT Greengrass brings local compute, messaging, data management, sync, and ML inference capabilities to edge devices.

subcommands.name: associate-service-role-to-account
subcommands.description: Associates a Greengrass service role with IoT Greengrass for your Amazon Web Services account in this Amazon Web Services Region.

subcommands.name: batch-associate-client-device-with-core-device
subcommands.description: Associates a list of client devices with a core device.

subcommands.name: batch-disassociate-client-device-from-core-device
subcommands.description: Disassociates a list of client devices from a core device.

subcommands.name: cancel-deployment
subcommands.description: Cancels a deployment.

subcommands.name: create-component-version
subcommands.description: Creates a component.

subcommands.name: create-deployment
subcommands.description: Creates a continuous deployment for a target, which is a Greengrass core device or group of core devices.

subcommands.name: delete-component
subcommands.description: Deletes a version of a component from IoT Greengrass.

subcommands.name: delete-core-device
subcommands.description: Deletes a Greengrass core device, which is an IoT thing.

subcommands.name: delete-deployment
subcommands.description: Deletes a deployment.

subcommands.name: describe-component
subcommands.description: Retrieves metadata for a version of a component.

subcommands.name: disassociate-service-role-from-account
subcommands.description: Disassociates the Greengrass service role from IoT Greengrass for your Amazon Web Services account in this Amazon Web Services Region.

subcommands.name: get-component
subcommands.description: Gets the recipe for a version of a component.

subcommands.name: get-component-version-artifact
subcommands.description: Gets the pre-signed URL to download a public or a Lambda component artifact.

subcommands.name: get-connectivity-info
subcommands.description: Retrieves connectivity information for a Greengrass core device.

subcommands.name: get-core-device
subcommands.description: Retrieves metadata for a Greengrass core device.

subcommands.name: get-deployment
subcommands.description: Gets a deployment.

subcommands.name: get-service-role-for-account
subcommands.description: Gets the service role associated with IoT Greengrass for your Amazon Web Services account in this Amazon Web Services Region.

subcommands.name: list-client-devices-associated-with-core-device
subcommands.description: Retrieves a paginated list of client devices that are associated with a core device.

subcommands.name: list-component-versions
subcommands.description: Retrieves a paginated list of all versions for a component.

subcommands.name: list-components
subcommands.description: Retrieves a paginated list of component summaries.

subcommands.name: list-core-devices
subcommands.description: Retrieves a paginated list of Greengrass core devices.

subcommands.name: list-deployments
subcommands.description: Retrieves a paginated list of deployments.

subcommands.name: list-effective-deployments
subcommands.description: Retrieves a paginated list of deployment jobs that IoT Greengrass sends to Greengrass core devices.

subcommands.name: list-installed-components
subcommands.description: Retrieves a paginated list of the components that a Greengrass core device runs.

subcommands.name: list-tags-for-resource
subcommands.description: Retrieves the list of tags for an IoT Greengrass resource.

subcommands.name: resolve-component-candidates
subcommands.description: Retrieves a list of components that meet the component, version, and platform requirements of a deployment.

subcommands.name: tag-resource
subcommands.description: Adds tags to an IoT Greengrass resource.

subcommands.name: untag-resource
subcommands.description: Removes a tag from an IoT Greengrass resource.

subcommands.name: update-connectivity-info
subcommands.description: Updates connectivity information for a Greengrass core device.
